question: Q-f5-consolidation-beyond-append-only
conjecture: Offline restructuring (sleep consolidation pass: store reorganization + compression + deltaW refresh) improves long-lag retention AND generalization beyond both raw-log append-only preservation and consolidation-off HSWM. Consolidation is established only if arm A dominates B and C at lag >= 4 by delta >= 10pp AND A's decay slope is significantly shallower in hierarchical model fit (intercept-only differences do not count).

arms.A: full HSWM (wake: typed actuation; sleep: consolidation pass - restructure/compress/deltaW)
arms.B: raw-log append-only control (everything preserved, same retrieval budget - isolates preservation)
arms.C: consolidation-off HSWM (store exists, sleep phase no-op - offline-phase ablation)
